record.title: FedNoRo: Towards Noise-Robust Federated Learning by Addressing Class Imbalance and Label Noise Heterogeneity
record.reason: 选择 Figure 2 而非 Figure 1：完整呈现按类别识别含噪客户端、差异化训练、知识蒸馏和距离感知聚合的核心两阶段贡献；Figure 1 仅对比噪声图模型。
record.scope_reason: Medical label quality and between-hospital disease imbalance directly motivate the method and its clinical per-class-noise assumption. Section 5 and Tables 1–2 evaluate diagnosis of five intracranial-hemorrhage subtypes in brain CT and eight skin diseases on ICH/ISIC2019. This is biomedical-primary empirical work despite a reusable federated-learning method; the study remains retrospective with simulated client partitions and injected label noise.

record.title: Graph Sampling-based Meta-Learning for Molecular Property Prediction
record.reason: 选择 Figure 2 而非 Figure 1：它把分子–性质关系图、候选子图池、可学习采样调度器以及分类/对比联合优化连成完整算法流程，最直接对应本文贡献。
record.scope_reason: Introduction frames early drug lead optimization and sparse assay labels; the molecule–property graph explicitly models correlated molecular side effects/properties. Section 4/Table 1 and analyses predict Tox21, SIDER, MUV, ToxCast and PCBA toxicity/side-effect/bioassay labels. This is biomedical drug-discovery research, not merely generic graph benchmarking; it is in-silico retrospective validation without new wet-lab or clinical efficacy evidence.

record.title: A Noisy-Label-Learning Formulation for Immune Repertoire Classification and Disease-Associated Immune Receptor Sequence Identification
record.reason: 审阅其他结果图后选择 Figure 1：其三个面板同时展示噪声标签协同修正、序列与受体库双层推断，以及 TCR-BERT/FT-Transformer 结构，直接解释核心方法；并非因图号默认选择。
record.scope_reason: The full abstract directly centers immune repertoire classification and disease-associated immune receptor sequence identification, evaluated on CMV and cancer data at both repertoire and sequence levels. The noisy-label method serves a primary computational immunology task, not an incidental biomedical benchmark.

record.title: Pseudo-Labeling Enhanced by Privileged Information and Its Application to In Situ Sequencing Images
record.reason: 选择 Table 3 而非通用教师–学生框架图，直接展示 ISS 条形码/细胞识别的恢复、NGS 一致性、错误发现与推理时间之间的实际权衡。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The work is motivated by decoding in-situ-sequencing microscopy barcodes for spatial transcriptomics, builds an ISS-specific PLePI-ISS framework and biological benchmarking resource, and evaluates cell calling against NGS abundance and existing ISS decoders. Body sections 1, 4.5 and 5.2–5.3 plus Tables 2–3 confirm primary biological experiments; COCO is an additional generic proof of concept, not grounds to exclude the biological research.

record.title: Differentially Private Partial Set Cover with Applications to Facility Location
record.reason: 选择 Figure 2 的两地区疫苗服务距离–预算曲线，直接说明算法在公共卫生应用中的隐私/可达性权衡；不以普通选址示意图代替实际评估。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The core theoretical method is general differentially private partial set cover, but its developed application and entire main-paper empirical evaluation address mobile vaccine-clinic placement. Section 3 gives a vaccine-distribution formulation using population travel patterns; Section 4/Table 1/Figure 2 test Charlottesville and Albemarle mobility populations and vaccination travel-distance/privacy tradeoffs. This is actual primary public-health service-delivery experimentation, not an incidental vaccine example.
